name: application-typing-indicator
title: Typing Indicator
description: Animated "X is typing…" row for chat threads, with an avatar and staggered bouncing dots — the label pluralizes automatically from a real list of typing users.
useWhen: Showing that one or more other users are actively composing a message in a chat thread.
You want the "X is typing…" / "X and Y are typing…" / "X and N others are typing…" copy generated from a real names array.
The indicator should disappear automatically when nobody is typing (pass an empty array).
avoidWhen: You need to show full message content, not just a composing signal — use chat-bubbles instead.
The presence signal isn't about active typing (e.g. just "online") — use a presence dot on an avatar instead.
Reduced motion must be strictly honored and no fallback exists — consider a static "typing…" label behind a prefers-reduced-motion check in your integration.
responsiveBehavior: The row is a single inline-flex line sized to its content; it fits naturally at the bottom of a chat thread at any width.
accessibility: The wrapper carries role='status' and aria-live='polite' so screen readers announce when someone starts or stops typing.
A visually hidden label states the full pluralized typing message; the animated dots are purely visual.
The component renders nothing when the names array is empty, so no stale or misleading status persists.

variants.title: Typing indicator
variants.description: Single-user typing indicator with avatar initials and a bouncing three-dot bubble, on a light surface.
accessibility: The animated dots are decorative; the sr-only label carries the actual status text.

variants.title: Typing indicator (Dark)
variants.description: The same single-user typing indicator, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Avatar and bubble colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
